overview_description.description: Infra.Market is a construction solutions company that creates a multi-product building materials brand, they are transforming the ecosystem through leveraging technology and scaling innovation. Infra.Market offers a wide range of construction materials, including cement, steel, chemicals, and more, catering to various needs within the construction industry. The platform is a one-stop shop for construction materials, leveraging technology to simplify procurement and logistics.
